dependencies.required_evidence: terminal retained resource, process, phase, scratch, and cleanup evidence

retained_evidence_analysis.rule: Consume only terminal Arm B evidence. Do not infer a phase when markers, complete peak-interval samples, or process identities are absent.

bounded_observer_replay.activation: retained evidence cannot attribute the authoritative peak interval
bounded_observer_replay.rule: Run one correction-only observer replay on the smallest frozen scope reproducing the suspected allocation lifetimes, with an observer-only K control.

q1_authorization: authoritative peak phase or explicit unattributed_peak classification is terminal
one coherent probability-identical allocation-lifetime hypothesis is named
reclaimable overlapping-lifetime lower bound reaches at least 1508229120 bytes
no sampled RSS value overrides VmHWM or cgroup memory.peak
instrumented diagnostic receipts confer zero resource qualification
claim_boundary: Arm B remains a strict memory failure regardless of archive outcome
attribution grants no compression, archive, or resource credit
a probability-affecting memory child becomes a new compression candidate
one correction-only observer successor is allowed; no scope or flag sweep is allowed
